title: SimpleX native metadata namespace version 1
description: While the Python owner remains alive, native profile ownership stays exclusive through startup cancellation and until worker termination is confirmed; unsuccessful cleanup does not authorize another owner. Parent-process-death isolation is not qualified.

sender_label.description: Local display name of the sender as assigned by this profile; falls back to the scoped sender identity.

sender_display_name.description: Peer-declared profile displayName supplied by the SDK; absent when not supplied.

sender_full_name.description: Peer-declared profile fullName supplied by the SDK; absent when not supplied.

member_id.description: Shared protocol member ID: the stable opaque group identity that survives localDisplayName changes. Group conversations only.

member_role.description: Group member role as reported by the SDK. Group conversations only.

msg_verified.description: SDK message-signature verdict; signed_no_key means the item was signed but no key was available to verify it.

public_facts.description: Explicit bridge projection allowlist; only these fields may cross transport boundaries.
